title: Tech Note: Saving and Loading Page Setups via JSON
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: GET PRINT OPTION / SET PRINT OPTION

historical_commentary.text: This note explicitly relies on the deprecated command _O_PAGE SETUP because, at the time, it was the only way to retrieve a form's print settings outside the form's own context; it still works today for classic forms but is a legacy technique for an increasingly legacy printing model (classic 4D forms with GDI/QuickDraw-style print settings).
related_updates: _O_PAGE SETUP is documented as deprecated in 4D's command reference and has no direct modern replacement outside form context; new development favors handling print/export via 4D Write Pro/4D View Pro or PDF generation commands

Classic form-based printing (GET/SET PRINT OPTION) is still supported in 4D but is not the direction of newer form/report technology (Qodly forms, ORDA-based reporting, 4D Write Pro/View Pro documents)
